column1: # The TUR programs compiled into the image (image/README.md, "Programs built
# into the image"). One line each, three fields separated by tabs:
#   the component's directory, a Cargo workspace
#   the program to build from it
# /usr/bin holds what a person types and what an assistant tool adapter
# starts; /usr/libexec/tur holds what units and other programs start.
# image/programs.sh reads this file in the build stage. A component
# that joins the image adds its line here, its directory to
# Containerfile.containerignore and a COPY to the Containerfile.
